topics.title: Save a survey draft
topics.body: Open a workspace with a retention policy. Enter a survey title, a question and its answer options, then select Save draft. You can edit the draft before publishing.

topics.title: Preview a saved draft
topics.body: After saving, select Preview draft. Choose an answer and use Check preview answer to verify the respondent controls. Preview answers stay in your browser and never enter survey results.

topics.title: Publish and share a link
topics.body: Publish the saved draft to create a fixed version of the questionnaire. Use Open respondent link to test the published version in a separate browser context. Responses belong to the version you shared.

topics.title: Export for JASP
topics.body: Select View results and then Export JASP CSV. The download includes responses.csv, a codebook and import instructions. Extract the archive and use the codebook to check measurement levels in JASP.
